lines.say: Soak your hands, and your fingertips turn into prunes.
lines.caption: Prune fingers

lines.say: But it's not the skin soaking up water.
lines.caption: Not soaking

lines.say: If the nerve to a finger is cut, that finger stays smooth.
lines.caption: Cut nerve

lines.say: Your nerves squeeze tiny blood vessels under the skin,
lines.caption: Vessels squeeze

lines.say: so the fingertip shrinks, and the skin buckles into ridges.
lines.caption: Ridges

lines.say: In a 2013 test, wrinkly fingers moved wet marbles faster.
lines.caption: Grip test

lines.say: The grooves drain water, like the tread on a tire.
lines.caption: Tire tread
